Monaco Explosion Leaves Three Wounded

An explosion at a residential building in Monaco has left three people wounded, with authorities investigating a deliberate attack. The incident occurred on Monday evening near the French border. Authorities are searching for a suspect believed to have detonated a makeshift bomb.
